skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts, roles, and principles of natural resource management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Planning and Conservation of Natural Resources
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the types and roles of planning and conservation of natural resources.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Principles and Criteria for Developing Natural Resource Plans
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles and criteria for developing natural resource plans.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: National Regulations on Approval and Review of Natural Resource Plans
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand national regulations regarding approval and review of natural resource plans.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Application of Knowledge in Natural Resource Planning
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge to determine types and contents of natural resource planning.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analysis and Application of Measures to Implement Natural Resource Plans
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and apply measures to implement natural resource plans.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Individual and Group Work in Natural Resource Planning
